snippet.title: The Blue Cut Hook - Exclusive trailer for G2G The Lazy Award
snippet.description:
The exclusive trailer for The Blue Cut Hook was showcased at G2G Event 2024, held on November 23-24, 2024, at The Luxus Grand Ballroom, Mall Glodok Kemayoran. This annual gaming festival in Indonesia gives players the chance to experience local games and see exclusive showcases from developers.

Follow our Social Media for more updates:
IG: @bluecuthook
X: @TheBlueCutHook

Download The Blue Cut Hook’s demo here:
https://plexusstudio.itch.io/the-blue-cut-hook

Wishlist The Blue Cut Hook on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3360770/The_Blue_Cut_Hook/
